title: Maximum Sorted Chunks in a Permutation
description: The array `nums` is a permutation of all integers from 0 through `n - 1`. Split it into the largest number of contiguous chunks such that sorting each chunk individually and concatenating the chunks produces the fully sorted array. Return the number of chunks. Input: the permutation `nums`. Output: the maximum chunk count.
constraints: nums is a permutation of [0, nums.length - 1]
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
